unproject_depth_map_to_point_map: unproject a batch of depth maps to 3D world coordinates using camera extrinsics and intrinsics
depth_to_world_coords_points: convert a depth map to world coordinates given camera intrinsic and extrinsic matrices
project_world_points_to_cam: transform 3D points to 2D pixel coordinates using camera extrinsics, intrinsics, and optional distortion
closed_form_inverse_se3: compute the inverse of batched 4x4 or 3x4 SE3 transformation matrices
cam_from_img: normalize predicted 2D tracks to camera coordinates using intrinsics and optional distortion undistortion
